subject: HSM chain-of-custody logs for SOC 2 — transfer & verification
messages:
From: Audit Team <audit-team@kestrelsec.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Paul Richards <paul.richards@finera.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: HSM chain-of-custody logs for SOC 2 audit — Redwood

Hi Olga,

Kestrel Security is preparing the evidence package for Finera's upcoming SOC 2 fieldwork. Please provide the chain-of-custody and transfer logs related to the HSM-backed keys used for customer data encryption (Finera tenant) for the window 2028-05-01 through 2028-06-30. Specifically we need:

- Timestamped access and operation logs (import, export, wrap/unwrap, backup, restore) for key IDs: rw-enc-202-3a, rw-enc-203-4b.
- HSM audit trail (seal/unseal events, operator IDs, attestation statements if available).
- KMS configuration snapshot (policy bindings, key aliases, rotation schedule) as of 2028-06-30.
- Evidence of key rotation events: rotation timestamps, rotation keys used, and verification checks.
- Any transfer paperwork / custodian sign-off for when keys were migrated or escrowed.

Preferred delivery: encrypted ZIP via SFTP (we can provide credentials), or a secure SharePoint link. Please indicate redaction plans if logs contain customer PII. Target delivery date for the bundle is 2028-07-18 to meet auditor sign-off timelines.

Attachment: audit_request_form_v2.pdf (fills scope and delivery preference).

Thanks,
Kestrel Security — Evidence Intake

--
Kestrel Security
security-ops@kestrelsec.com
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Audit Team <audit-team@kestrelsec.com>
Cc: Paul Richards <paul.richards@finera.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Jul 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: HSM chain-of-custody logs for SOC 2 audit — Redwood

Hi — thanks for the clear scope. Confirming receipt and we can meet the 2028-07-18 target. Plan below: 

1) Scope confirmation: we will produce the HSM audit trail for the requested key IDs and the KMS snapshot as of 2028-06-30. Please confirm whether you require the full operator IDs or a pseudonymized mapping (we typically provide operator IDs hashed and a separate custodian mapping under NDA).

2) Delivery format: we'll prepare an encrypted bundle (AES-256 ZIP) and push to your SFTP endpoint. If you prefer DocuSign for the release authorization, mention that in your reply.

3) Timeline: preliminary log export by 2028-07-15; final packaged bundle by 2028-07-17 (internal approval permitting).

4) Redaction: we will remove any customer PII from stack traces and session notes; timestamps and event IDs remain intact.

I've attached a short checklist to capture the exact artifacts we'll include — prelim_scope_checklist.xlsx.

Marissa (Compliance) and Ben (Sales) are looped in for approvals and delivery coordination. Laura — we will need your sign-off on the release authorization template and any contract-level NDAs before sending.

Regards,

Olga Petrov
Sr. Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0183

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Jul 2028 13:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HSM chain-of-custody logs for SOC 2 — internal tasking

OLGA / team — quick task breakdown so we move fast: 

- Ben: please coordinate the SFTP credentials and DocuSign link (if Finera needs an executed release). Confirm the exact SFTP path and dropbox TTL; Kestrel asked for sftp delivery.
- Laura: can you review and sign the release_authorization_template.docx once I populate the event list? We should ensure the NDA covers operator mapping if we choose to disclose a mapping table.
- Olga: Marissa will assemble the CSV exports (HSM audit events) and produce a rotation timeline doc (signed by custodians).

Notes: double-verify key IDs rw-enc-202-3a and rw-enc-203-4b exist in the KMS snapshot (I ran a quick cross-check but will need the full export). If there were any manual wraps during migration in April, include the operator sign-offs.

Expected internal due dates: logs export (2028-07-14 EOD), bundle prep for review (2028-07-16), final out (2028-07-17 after Laura sign-off).

Thanks — will update the JIRA SUP-3421 with attachments when ready.

-Marissa
Head of Compliance, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Audit Team <audit-team@kestrelsec.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Paul Richards <paul.richards@finera.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Jul 2028 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: HSM chain-of-custody logs for SOC 2 audit — Redwood

Thanks, Olga and team — we received the secure SFTP upload (path: sftp://audit-upload.kestrelsec.com/redwood/finera/2028-07-16). We're doing an initial ingestion now and will reach out with any follow-up clarifications by EOD Wednesday (2028-07-19).

A couple of small asks while we ingest: 
- Can you include a short manifest.txt inside the bundle that maps each CSV/JSON file to the artifact type and the time-range it covers?
- If you used any intermediary key wrapping keys during migration, include the wrapping key alias (redacted to the alias only) in the manifest.

If you can drop a signed release_authorization_template.docx to the same SFTP folder, that will speed auditor acceptance. Otherwise we can accept a signed PDF pulled from DocuSign.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — we'll loop Paul on any client-specific items.

Best,
Kestrel Security — Evidence Intake
security-ops@kestrelsec.com
